description: On since 1.17.0: spike P7 passed (Claude Code 2.1.325, 2026-11-15: the pre-export lint hook stopped this plugin's build of a bad MapSpec, let an unrelated command through untouched, and the credentials reminder reached the model). On Windows the plugin's server launcher points the two commands at the plugin's own Python on each start (hooks/pin_python.py), because python3 there is the Store stub. Hooks act only on this plugin's own files (MAP-ED-005). hooks/README.md says how to turn one off.
